item.title: The Philippines: PhilTower MIDC Aligns Digital Infrastructure, Workforce
item.description: PhilTower MIDC has joined the People Management Association of the Philippines to strengthen the country’s digital infrastructure while advancing workforce development and professional standards.

item.title: Malaysia: Pioneering Advanced Biomass and Biofuel Solutions
item.description: Malaysia is advancing low-carbon technologies through biomass, biofuels, hydrogen, and carbon capture research, fostering a circular bioeconomy, regional collaboration and sustainable industrial growth.

item.title: Vietnam: Digital Leap Set to Transform the Real Estate Market
item.description: Vietnam’s new mandatory property identification codes aim to fully digitalise the real estate sector, improving transparency, reducing transaction costs and aligning the market with international standards.

item.title: Singapore and Norway Activate EFTA Digital Economy Agreement
item.description: Singapore and Norway have activated the EFTA–Singapore Digital Economy Agreement, enhancing cross-border digital trade, data flows, cybersecurity, AI governance and opportunities for SMEs in a secure, paperless system.

item.title: Malaysia: AI Governance to Protect Innovation, Intellectual Property
item.description: Malaysia is advancing a proposed AI Governance Bill to ensure ethical, transparent, and accountable AI development while protecting intellectual property and supporting continued innovation.

item.title: Australia: Sourcing Agreement Strengthens Public Sector Digital Transformation
item.description: The new ICT sourcing agreement modernises government digital infrastructure, ensures cost certainty, strengthens data governance and supports AI and cloud adoption across public sector agencies.

item.title: The Philippines: Advancing Digital Inclusion and AI Training
item.description: The Bayanihan SIM Project and AI training initiatives empower Filipino students, teachers and MSMEs with nationwide connectivity, bridging the digital divide and supporting inclusive growth and innovation.

item.title: Hong Kong: Sea Urchin-Inspired Autonomous Underwater Sensors
item.description: Researchers replicate sea urchin spine structure using 3D printing to create self powered underwater sensing materials for monitoring marine environments.

item.title: Vietnam: Developing a Skilled High-Technology Workforce
item.description: Vietnam is prioritising the development of a high-quality science and technology workforce under Resolution 57 to master strategic technologies, drive innovation and strengthen the country’s competitiveness.

item.title: Singapore: National Programme to Accelerate AI Adoption
item.description: Singapore’s National AI Impact Programme aims to accelerate AI adoption across businesses while developing 100,000 AI‑bilingual workers, fostering enterprise transformation and responsible innovation.
